revisions.name: $th_block_exec
revisions.reason: Review 20261121 WATX compile-time dispatch: a (dispatch-drain) macro follows each of the two fallback call_indirect handler entries. It expands to (call $tramp_drive) only in a no-tail-call TRAMPOLINE_DISPATCH build and to nothing otherwise; it is the same driver call lib/dispatch-trampoline.js used to insert as text into the compat source, at the same two sites. Tail and compat artifacts compiled without the export guards are byte-identical to the previous overlay builds. No callback producer, EIP write, boundary call or lifetime changed.

It expands to (call $tramp_drive) only in a no-tail-call TRAMPOLINE_DISPATCH build and to nothing otherwise; it replaces the identical text edit lib/dispatch-trampoline.js applied to the compat source.
